# WATAM DeFi Intelligence (full)

> On-chain DEX analytics for token teams, exchange listing and risk teams and funds. Swaps are decoded directly from the
> chain on Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Ethereum, Base, BNB Smart Chain, Monad, Avalanche C-Chain, Solana, TON. Every anomaly finding carries an Evidence Card that answers five questions. Independent analytics; not affiliated with the projects or exchanges listed.

Data as of 29 Oct 2026, 23:58 UTC. Source: https://app.wearetheartmakers.com/api/public/catalog (refreshed every 12 h on EVM networks, every 3 h on TON, every 1 h on Solana).

## The five evidence questions

1. What was observed? The metric and its unit, the observed value against the expected baseline, and the window in UTC.
2. Where is the evidence? Network, chain id and the token's contract; the block range; each measured pool with its protocol and decoder family; the swap count and the five largest transactions; the RPC providers and ingestion runs covering the window.
3. How was it computed? The method and its version, the baseline window and value (frozen when the anomaly starts), the parameters and the detector's facts.
4. How much can we trust it? Hours expected against hours fully covered, every gap, the checks that passed, and the caveats and alternative explanations.
5. How can it be checked independently? The detection SQL with its SHA-256, and a recipe for any public JSON-RPC node that needs no access to our database.

Evidence Cards cover anomaly findings on the EVM networks; Solana and TON entries have coverage and verified swaps but no anomaly
findings yet. Findings describe the verified pools that were measured, never a token's whole market, and none is an accusation.
USD values are not part of the evidence.

## Catalog status rules

- available: at least 72 hours of verified history
- collecting: history is still being gathered; the ready date is an estimate
- stale: coverage not refreshed for more than 28 hours
